verdict.rationale: Railway is an all-in-one cloud provider, and a built-in image CDN with on-demand resizing is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions image resizing, image optimization, or an image CDN. Networking, load-balancing and edge-region claims are adjacent features, not image transformation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resize and optimize images on demand via a built-in image CDN
